title: Suppress CS8002 warning for modern .NET TFMs
reviewer_concern:
CS8002 must not be automatically suppressed when targeting .NET Standard 2.0 or lower.  Assemblies that were built targeting those frameworks can be run on .NET Framework, which still checks strong names, so the warnings are justified.

When targeting .NET Standard 2.1, CS8002 could in principle be suppressed because no version of .NET Framework supports .NET Standard 2.1.  However, I recommend that the SDK not suppress CS8002 on any version of .NET Standard, because this will be easier for users to understand.  There is hardly any reason to target .NET Standard 2.1 nowadays anyway.
